title: Codec at SemEval-2022 Task 5: Multi-Modal Multi-Transformer Misogynous Meme Classification Framework
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical architecture of a multi-modal transformer system for identifying misogynous memes. While identifying misogyny addresses a social and ethical issue, the paper is a system description for a shared task competition rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, spiritual traditions, theology, or ethical frameworks themselves.
